blends.name: Impetus Worker
blends.desc:
Take your chance and win an Impetus Worker!
It's possible that you will need it in the future.🌱

The Impetus NFT collection is designed to reward the community for their good deeds with special tokens that can be collected and combined with others. If you collect all of the special tokens (not all have been released yet), you can create the ultimate Impetus NFT! 🌱

You can fill in this form to get even more NFTs.🌱
https://forms.gle/8EhwfBKUi6VcNhpt5

To get Happy Impetus follow the link below:
https://neftyblocks.com/c/impetustoken/drops/30831
